payload.claim: The docstring cites a bare line number, "(line 1322)", with no file name, to point at `_run_agent`'s handling of a scripted exception. The repository's own citation convention (seen in `events.py`'s `_Family.where`, and in DESIGN.md section citations) deliberately avoids raw line numbers because they drift as a file is edited; this is the only such bare line-number citation in `tests/test_session.py`, a 3900+ line file this very diff adds hundreds of lines to, so it is likely to go stale and point at the wrong line after the next edit above it.
